Voat has a lack of critical volume on many subs, including /v/science and /v/technology. My proposal is having an "RSS auto-post" feature that the mods can turn on/off during dry spells.

The concept is simple: a mod can set up a news aggregator like Google News with key words, then auto-post to the sub.

A variation of auto-post is auto-propose, where the post gets prepared but the mod still has to "okay" it.

What do my fellow users think?
Set up an RSS auto-poster until user submission increases?

Hm. I come to a user-centric site like Voat to see what other people think is worth talking about.

So some days /v/science might move slowly; that’s fine, maybe there was no news today that captured any user’s attention. And some days it might get busy, when something big happens and the whole internet is abuzz. Users are inconsistent. If I wanted consistent news I would read that RSS feed from Google News myself.

As Voat grows that cycle will probably get shorter from days to hours to even minutes, until the big subs are busy all the time. What we can do is post more, but not just for the sake of posting more. Post more things that interest you, and then stay and engage in discussion. I don’t like the idea of trying to force growth with automated content, because all you get is a lot of content with no more discussion than before.
